findings.label: Shared cached array on admin path
findings.detail: On a cache hit, the admin branch of both pages assigns the shared cached array instance to component state (setAllChecks(data) / setChecks(c)) rather than a fresh fetch result. Safe today because consumers only filter/map, but a future in-place sort/mutation would corrupt the cache for the next reader. Suggest a 'treat as read-only' comment on the fetch helpers.

findings.label: createKeyedCache is dead-but-tested
findings.detail: The keyed cache (normalized-key, invalidate-clears-all) is implemented with 5 passing unit tests but wired to no production fetch; getAccuracyChecksForAnalyst and getAllAccuracyChecks are themselves callerless dead code. Not a defect; the keyed path ships unused.
